    Profile

    Roy Mustang is an alchemist known as the "Flame Alchemist", whose soul has been summoned from another world. His style of alchemy utilizes his signature white gloves to ignite flames powerful enough to strike fear in the hearts of both enemies and allies alike. Beyond his careless demeanor lies great ambition and a sympathetic nature.
